title: Kubva Pakadzika peTsime
intro: Rwendo rwemweya mudiki rwakatanga nechiratidzo chine simba chezvisikwa zvekudenga zvichikotama neruremekedzo. Hupenyu hwemunhu uyu hwakaratidzwa nekutengeswa kwakanyanya kubva kune avo vari pedyo, zvichiteverwa nemakore euranda nekuiswa mujeri zvisina kururama. Asi kuburikidza nekutenda kusingazununguki uye kutungamirirwa naMwari, munhu uyu akasimuka kubva mugomba rakaderera kusvika pakuva mumwe wevanhu vane simba kwazvo muumambo hukuru. Unogona here kuburitsa pachena hunhu hwemuranda uyu anoshamisa waAllah?
clues: Ndakaratidzwa chiratidzo chenyeredzi gumi nerimwe, zuva, nemwedzi zvichindipfugamira
Ndaive mwana aidiwa zvikuru nemubereki wangu, izvo zvakaita kuti hama dzangu dzive negodo
Ndakabatwa nehama dzangu, ndikabviswa hembe, ndikakandwa mugomba rakadzika, rine rima
Ndakatengeswa sechigadzirwa pamusika ndikaendeswa kure nenyika yangu
Mukadzi ane simba akaedza kundikanganisa, uye ndakaiswa mujeri nekuda kwekuramba kukwezva kwake
Ndakakomborerwa nechipo chekududzira zviroto, uye ndakamuka kubva pakuva musungwa akakanganikwa kuenda kuva gurukota guru reIjipita

arabic: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّۢ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌۭ مُّرْتَابٌ
verse: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic." (40:34)
